name: apply-modifiers
description: Modifier keywords that can follow a 'zone face apply' condition value to vary it over space, time, FISH callbacks, or convergence response.

modifiers.purpose: Apply a spatial gradient to scalar values.
notes: Always specify an origin when the default origin would make the gradient ambiguous.

modifiers.purpose: Multiply the base value by a FISH function return value each step.
notes: The FISH function should return a scalar or vector compatible with the applied condition.
The function name is an unquoted FISH symbol; a quoted string is rejected. Verified against FLAC3D 9.7.

modifiers.purpose: Evaluate a FISH multiplier separately for each face or gridpoint affected by the condition.
notes: For face-based conditions, the function can use the zone pointer and side number.
Takes an unquoted FISH symbol, like 'fish'. Verified against FLAC3D 9.7.

modifiers.purpose: Control the applied magnitude based on mechanical convergence ratio.
notes: Use ramp to increase load gradually; use reduce to remove a condition gradually.

FLAC3D 9.x syntax is 'servo' followed by sub-keywords: latency <i>, lower-bound <f>, lower-multiplier <f> (must be > 1), maximum <f>, minimum <f>, ramp, ratio (average/convergence/global/local/maximum), reduce, upper-bound <f>, upper-multiplier <f> (must be < 1). The 7.0 hyphenated servo-* keywords are rejected by 9.x. Verified against FLAC3D 9.7.

modifiers.purpose: Help local-axis boundary logic respect specified symmetry planes.
notes: Most useful for velocity, acceleration, and reaction conditions based on local axes.

modifiers.purpose: Vary a condition through a table-controlled multiplier.
notes: Useful for staged loading, histories, hydrographs, and dynamic input records.

In 9.x the table name must be a quoted string (table 'name'); an unquoted name is rejected. The 7.0 table-creep/-dynamic/-fluid/-mechanical/-step/-thermal variants no longer exist. Verified against FLAC3D 9.7.

modifiers.purpose: Apply a per-component variation profile to a condition value.
notes: Validated against the FLAC2D 9.0 binary modifier set after 'zone face apply <kw> <value> ?'.

modifiers.purpose: Update the direction of an applied vector quantity each step to follow the moving face/gridpoint frame.
notes: Accepted after gridpoint-based vector conditions (velocity, velocity-normal, acceleration, ...); rejected after face-based stress conditions (stress-normal, stress-xx, ...). Verified against FLAC3D 9.7.

notes_general: 'range' is treated as a modifier-position keyword by the parser (it follows the value, like the other modifiers).

'symmetry' is accepted only after local-axis conditions (velocity-local / -normal / -tangential, reaction-local / -normal / -tangential, acceleration-local / -normal / -tangential). It is not a universal modifier.

Commands parse-and-execute incrementally: a command line with a trailing invalid token may already have executed its valid prefix before the error is raised (e.g. 'zone gridpoint fix velocity-x 0 <badtoken>' fixes velocity-x, then errors). An error message does not mean the command had no effect. Verified FLAC3D 9.7.

'zone face apply-remove' with no keyword removes ALL apply conditions in the range; a misspelled first keyword is treated as a trailing extra parameter, so the remove-everything action executes before the error is raised. Verified FLAC3D 9.7.
